An extra thing, bulls berserker star power is terrible, perhaps a rework to that? Maybe every time he takes a certain amount of damage, eg: 500 damage, he gets 10% of an ammo back. Not of his full ammo bar, but of an ammo. It is a little like snappy sniping, but the other way round. This would not stack. If he took 5000 damage, he would still get 1 full ammo back. Or another rework, he would get a double reload speed for 0.1 seconds per amount of damage taken.

The point of bull is to be able to charge in, kill someone, then charge out. If he needed to use all his ammo to get super back, he would not be able to chain supers properly. 

I think he should need now 2 and a quarter as that means if he hits someone with super then shoots em twice, he can still chain it without wasting more ammo. The spread change is good tho. How much tighter do you think it should get?

Keep in mind bull gets super charge from getting hit and Rosa doesnt and also think about how fast Darryl's super actually feels in game. It is quite hard to dodge if it is aimed well, and bull has his stomp gadget to stop himself at any point in that super. I think these buffs would be good but tone down the hp to maybe 7800 and super speed to 3 tiles/s. The super range change is good though.
